messages.subject: Now I am using tags$div() to hide panels that I don't want, but can I remove it completely?
parts: You can use bootstrapPage instead of pageWithSidebar, then you can use whatever kind of layout you want inside. You might want to look at http://getbootstrap.com for some layout ideas.
